exposure: combined mitral and aortic valve disease
cohort: 134 pregnant women with heart disease admitted to Hue Central Hospital, Vietnam, between January 2017 and December 2020
finding: Pregnant women with cardiovascular disorders experience a higher rate of complications affecting both mother and fetus.
mod_finding: 66.7% of high-risk patients underwent cesarean section.
gest_age: Gestational age over 35 weeks was achieved in 55.6% of the high-risk group and 92.8% of the low-risk group.
birth_weight: The mean birth weight was 2800.0 +/- 438.2 g in the high-risk group and 2988.4 +/- 390.6 g in the low-risk group.
